findings.summary: admit_task_definitions accepts a read/write with at least one binding on any connection, and an answer with none, but tool_specs exposes only capabilities whose bindings share exactly one connection (silent continue). In a profile with two connections or two bindings of one contract (PR-09 allows both), a definition is admitted yet the run never gets that tool; containment in the routable set is proven only by the fixture-profile golden test. No ADR 0028 rule or acceptance step is violated and the silent drop predates this task; 2c.5/2c.6 must intersect the definition with the routable set or refuse at admission (PR-10).
findings.evidence: src/e_agent/kernel/registry.py:403-415 vs src/e_agent/server/bootstrap.py:100-114; tests/unit/plugins/erp/domain/test_task_definitions.py test_task_capabilities_match_golden (fixture profile only)

findings.summary: Budget narrowing compares only model_fields_set at admission, but the admitted Budgets record carries every default (e.g. max_driver_turns 12). The 2c.6 consumer must merge only the set fields into the profile budgets, or a definition that narrows one field silently widens the others back to defaults (D7).

Defaulted declarations are reported only in AdmissionReport.defaulted_declarations, not in /health/ready or the evidence bundle. ADR 0029 Operations requires release evidence to list them; no Phase 2 plan task owns that follow-up, so it is untracked.
findings.evidence: src/e_agent/kernel/registry.py:66-69; docs/adr/0029-capability-effect-declarations.md Consequences/Operations; docs/plans/2026-10-14-phase2-execution-ir.md (no task names defaulted-declaration reporting)

findings.summary: Admission does not check that acceptance.required_effects name write capabilities and required_answer names an answer capability; a misdeclared definition would be admitted and always end ACCEPTANCE_UNMET. Fails closed; the ERP definitions are correct per tests.

Two-phase admission: admit() lists a pack as admitted while its definitions are still staged, and only admit_plugins calls admit_task_definitions. Every production path (cli, api, worker, scripts/qualify_model.py, release_report.py, capture_model_replays.py) goes through build_runtime -> admit_plugins, so live refusal and definition admission always run before a run starts; a future composition root that skips the second step resolves no definition (fail-safe).

check_wheels.py (acceptance step 4) is not in the full gate evidence; its pass rests on the implementer's report. check_core_only.py and the full pytest (1105 passed) are in the gate on clean commit 22ca83e.
